title: Convolution as a linear operator; convolutional networks
summary: Discrete convolution and cross-correlation as linear, translation-equivariant operators; kernels, padding, stride and output size; multiple filters, ReLU and pooling; parameter counts versus fully connected layers; a small CNN and transfer learning.
